thread:
Maya (PM): hey team — we need a quick callout on milestone scaling. hit a blocker: Dedicated infra is tighter than expected and we need to decide what to defer to keep launch date.
Noah (Eng): can you list the candidate cuts?
Maya (PM): short list: 1) Promptstore export UI, 2) Embeddings v2 (quantized) for batch jobs, 3) Per-route cost telemetry in console, 4) A/B rollout automation rules.
Sana (Design): from UX POV promptstore export is lightweight, we can ship CSV only initially and iterate. :+1:
Noah (Eng): embeddings v2 is the heavy one — needs kernel tuning and QA. likely adds 2–3 weeks if we keep it in MVP.
Leo (SRE): Dedicated capacity target for launch is 6x lower than ideal. autoscaling warmup and #3 telemetry both increase memory/metrics pressure.
Oliver (PM): proposal: keep feature set that enables customer workflows, defer anything that materially increases infra risk. i.e., defer embeddings v2 and full per-route cost for MVP, keep export CSV + A/B manual toggles.
Maya (PM): that maps to two options:
- Option A (keep date): MVP = core API + promptstore CSV + A/B manual toggles; defer embeddings v2 & telemetry. timeline unchanged.
- Option B (shift by 3 wks): include embeddings v2 + telemetry and keep current milestone date +3w.
Noah (Eng): quick numbers: Option A => lower infra ops, fewer regression tests. Option B => more ops debt but better unit economics out of gate.
Sana (Design): for customers the visible difference between A/B manual toggles vs automation is small, so A is acceptable.
Leo (SRE): also consider soft-launch: open to limited tenants with Option B behind flag to reduce load. that requires canary infra though.
Maya (PM): good point — canary path could enable partial Option B without delaying. estimate: 1 week to set up canary infra and gating.
Oliver (PM): so we have hybrid Option C: ship MVP as Option A for GA, enable embeddings v2 behind flag to 5 pilot tenants (canary) — full rollout after +3w.
Noah (Eng): engineering timeline for Option C: +1w for canary infra, +2w for embeddings stabilization behind flag. doable if we prioritize.
Sana (Design): need a short copy/UX for the pilot flag state, I can deliver in 2 days.
Maya (PM): decision checklist: launch date on track? yes if we pick A/C. customer impact? minimal with export CSV + pilot. cost/ops? acceptable.
Oliver (PM): recommend Option C. keeps public GA on schedule and reduces risk.
Leo (SRE): +1 for C. requires a one-time ops window; I can own it.
Noah (Eng): +1 for C, will reorder sprint to prioritize the gating and test harness.
Maya (PM): consensus = Option C. action items: Noah -> plan gating + embeddings flag (ASAP). Leo -> canary infra runbook + RBAC for pilots. Sana -> UX copy for pilot flag. Oliver -> update launch comms to mention pilot. I'll update milestone doc and notify sales.
deploy-bot: @channel noted: milestone status set to "GA on time, canary pilot for embeddings".
Maya (PM): thanks — will follow up with a short RFC and a 15min sync for implementation tomorrow 10:30am.
